# SMSApp — release-scope reference

SMSApp separates job administration from SMS transport. The web admin authenticates the owner, selects one registered phone and either its completed contact sync or a CSV, normalizes and previews recipients, snapshots one message, and requires an explicit dispatch action. Firebase stores device, contact-generation, batch, recipient, claim, and outcome state. The selected Android phone performs each SMS send through its configured SIM.

## First-release limits

- Distribution: Google Play, "SMS Mobile App", version 1.7.0: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aoneahsan.smsapp
- Android application ID: `com.aoneahsan.smsapp`.
- Sender: one owner-managed Android phone per job.
- Enrollment: off by default and explicitly enabled on the phone.
- SIM: one configured default SMS subscription; no per-job dual-SIM selector.
- Contacts: permission plus a separate owner-initiated device-scoped cloud sync.
- CSV: UTF-8, recognized phone header, at most 5 MiB.
- Job: one message and at most 5,000 unique eligible destinations.
- Pacing: configured between 30 and 120 seconds per attempt by default.

## Destination safety

The release accepts only ordinary Pakistani mobile destinations in the `030`–`036` ranges. Unambiguous `03…`, `923…`, `00923…`, and `+923…` values normalize to E.164. Foreign numbers, landlines, short codes, service or premium destinations, malformed values, and unknown ranges are excluded. The policy runs at import, persistence/release, and Android dispatch, with no override.

The prefix policy cannot prove recipient consent, number ownership, service availability, account balance, tariff, package inclusion, or delivery. The owner remains responsible for lawful sending and carrier charges.

## Result semantics

Pending means not yet dispatched. A claim assigns a bounded lease to the selected phone. Sent means Android returned successful sent callbacks for the message parts; it is not a delivery guarantee. A confirmed error becomes failed. If Android may have accepted the message but the result cannot be proved, the outcome is uncertain and must not be automatically retried.

## Privacy and platform boundaries

SMSApp is send-only. It does not read or upload received SMS, call logs, location, advertising identifiers, or legacy external-storage contents. It is not a default SMS handler. There is no cloud SMS gateway, public phone pool, desktop sender, or npm product in this milestone. iOS: removed 2026-10-30 — re-add when an Apple Developer account exists.
